value.rationale: The canonical six-point branch locus exhausts P1(F5), making this a natural smallest-field boundary of the Humbert–Edge type-five moduli. Explicit degree-34 Frobenius factorization and mixed ordinary/superspecial decomposition determine all extension-field point counts and the complete Newton polygon, a concrete natural invariant not numerically determined by prior abstract Jacobian splitting. The claim is not merely rephrasing group-theoretic decomposition.
